items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Yeah, I helped Percy too. Percy was playing drums.

ctx.x: Yes, with a bow. Three string bass. Three string. I think it was a G, D, and A spread. And he keep putting in the Killing Melody Black plan. That's the first book. He had all kinds of orchestration music. He taught all his grandsons. He was all happy to say. You studied with your grandfather then, Willis? All of us. Percy and Earl.
Yeah, I helped Percy too. Percy was playing drums. You know he was playing trumpet? Yeah, he started on drums.

Yes, I remember. I never heard him on drums. Other people have told me that. They used to hear him on drums. Yeah, I used to get a little job, you know. Get a little work in the cinema. When did you stop playing, Mr. Humphrey? How late did you work on it?
